title: docs(polli-cli): document registering an image my-model
author: Circuit-Overtime
pr_body_excerpt:
Documents how to register a community **image** model from the CLI.

- `test --modality image` before `create`, and what the probe reports back
- how `--input-modalities text,image` advertises image-edit support, surfaced in the `inputs` column
- the two billing modes: `request` (per generated image) vs `tokens` (per 1M, verified against `COMMUNITY_IMAGE_TOKEN_PRICE_FIELDS`)
- `--modality` is fixed at creation

Reduced to the docs. The `my-models.ts` flags land in #13491; the generic `polli api` pass-through is a separate product decision tracked in #13385.

Co-authored-by: @Circuit-Overtime

gist.headline: Image models find their paperwork
gist.blurb: The Polli CLI guide now walks community image-model gardeners through registration before the pixels start blooming. It also explains the small but important choices hiding behind modality, inputs, and billing.
gist.summary: Documented registering a community image model with Polli CLI, including `test --modality image` probing, `--input-modalities text,image` image-edit advertising, request-versus-token billing, and the creation-time-fixed `--modality` setting.
gist.impact: Community model builders can now verify an image backend before creation, expose image-edit support through the `inputs` column, and select billing with the relevant image pricing fields in view.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy CLI registration desk in a garden shed: Polli checks a glowing image-model seed packet with a clipboard while a retro terminal displays a successful image probe, and two labeled jars represent per-request and per-token billing. A small code-plant has both text and image leaves, representing advertised image-edit inputs.
